findings.claim: `MeshBuilder.triangleCount` is never read. Nothing in src/, tests/, harness/ or guardrails/ uses it; the only `triangleCount` matches are an unrelated journal field in harness/lib/journal.ts.
findings.suggestedFix: Delete the getter and its doc comment (geometry.ts:134-137). Geometry output does not change.

findings.claim: The render barrel re-exports seven names that nothing imports through it: `frameWidthFor`, `LIGHT_DIRECTION`, `TOON_STEPS`, `attachOutline`, `groundMesh`, `outlinedFlatMesh` and `type RenderRole`. This makes the public seam look wider than it is.
findings.evidence: src/render/index.ts:5 `export { CAMERA, cameraAngles, cameraDistance, createCameraRig, frameWidthFor, ... }`; :8 `... toonShade, LIGHT_DIRECTION, TOON_STEPS, TOP_FACE_MIN_Y ...`; :9 `export { attachOutline, groundMesh, outlinedFlatMesh, solidMesh, type RenderRole } from './outline.ts';`. Every importer of src/render/index.ts (src/game.ts:9, tests/render/*.test.ts, tests/content/drivers.test.ts:7, harness/tests/preserve*.test.ts, and harness/screens/scene.ts:182, which uses playerLivery, createRaceScene, createMaterials and buildCar) uses none of these seven. A grep outside src/ for attachOutline|frameWidthFor|LIGHT_DIRECTION|TOON_STEPS|outlinedFlatMesh|groundMesh|RenderRole finds no matches. Inside src they are imported directly from their modules (car.ts:15, dust.ts:14, scene.ts:22).
findings.suggestedFix: Remove those seven names from the re-export lists in src/render/index.ts and leave the modules' own exports alone. Keep solidMesh only if someone imports it; it also has no importer through the index, so it can go too.

findings.claim: Four module exports are only used inside their own file: `smoothNormals` (geometry.ts), `attachOutline` and `CREASE_ANGLE_DEG` (outline.ts, apart from the barrel), and `OUTLINE_PX_AT_844` and `MaterialKind` (materials/index.ts). Dropping the `export` keyword gives them a smaller surface and doesn't change behaviour.
findings.evidence: geometry.ts:167 `export function smoothNormals` is used only at geometry.ts:150. outline.ts:19 `export const CREASE_ANGLE_DEG = 25` is used only at outline.ts:55. outline.ts:84 `export function attachOutline` is used only at outline.ts:104 (plus the index.ts:9 re-export, which nothing imports). materials/index.ts:36 `export const OUTLINE_PX_AT_844` is used only at :148 and :173. materials/index.ts:20 `export type MaterialKind` is used only at :136. A grep over src/, tests/, harness/ and guardrails/ finds no other importer.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove `export` from these declarations (after the index.ts re-export of attachOutline is dropped). No other change is needed.

findings.claim: outline.ts builds an all-ink palette attribute twice with the same expression: once for the decal-stripped hull and once for the crease lines.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a local `const inkAttribute = (count: number): BufferAttribute => paletteAttribute(new Uint8Array(count).fill(paletteIndex('ink')));` in outline.ts and call it at both sites. The bytes come out identical.

findings.claim: The 2D point type `[number, number]` is declared privately in two render modules and spelled out by hand a third time in scene.ts, even though shadow outlines pass from props.ts through scene.ts into track.ts.
findings.evidence:
src/render/props.ts:12 `type Pt = [number, number];`
src/render/track.ts:29 `type Pt = [number, number];`
src/render/scene.ts:87 `const shadowOutlines: [number, number][][] = [];` (filled by placeShadow, which returns props' Pt[], and passed to buildGroundChunks, which takes track's `readonly Pt[][]`)
findings.suggestedFix: Export one `type Pt2 = [number, number]` (e.g. next to `Vec3` in geometry.ts), import it in props.ts, track.ts and scene.ts, and delete the two local aliases. This is a types-only change.

findings.claim: car.ts writes its geometry return type as `ReturnType<MeshBuilder['build']>` three times. That type is just `BufferGeometry`, which the other render modules name directly.
findings.evidence:
src/render/car.ts:68 `export function buildCarGeometry(l: CarLivery): ReturnType<MeshBuilder['build']> {`
src/render/car.ts:129 `export function buildRoundelGeometry(number: number): ReturnType<MeshBuilder['build']> {`
src/render/car.ts:169 `export function buildMarkerGeometry(): ReturnType<MeshBuilder['build']> {`
geometry.ts:140 declares `build(): BufferGeometry`; track.ts:58 and outline.ts use `BufferGeometry` directly.
findings.suggestedFix: Add `type BufferGeometry` to the existing `three` import in car.ts (line 9) and use it in the three signatures. This is a types-only change.

findings.claim: The scene-graph comment, which tests and gates rely on, says each car Group holds the 'body mesh + player ▼ marker'. It leaves out the 'car-roundel' mesh that every car also carries.
findings.evidence:
src/render/scene.ts:12 `//   ├─ cars     one Group per car (userData.kind = 'car'), body mesh + player ▼ marker`
src/render/car.ts:191-193 `const body = solidMesh(buildCarGeometry(l), mats, 'car-body'); const roundel = solidMesh(buildRoundelGeometry(l.number), mats, 'car-roundel'); root.add(body, roundel);`
findings.suggestedFix: Change the comment to `body mesh, roof roundel + player ▼ marker`. Only the comment changes.
